name: CreateIndex

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. The knowledge base is created in this workspace. For details on how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID，即在该业务空间中创建知识库。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the knowledge base. The name must be 1 to 20 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and colons (:)
parameters.help_zh: 知识库名称。长度为 1~20 个字符，支持中文、英文、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）和半角冒号（:）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the knowledge base.

Valid values:

unstructured: A knowledge base for document search or audio/video content. The default scenario for document search is basic document Q&A.<props="china"> To create other scenarios, you must also pass the knowledgeType and knowledgeScene parameters.</props>

<props="china">

structured: A knowledge base for data queries or image-based Q&A.

</props>

The type of a knowledge base cannot be changed after it is created
parameters.help_zh:
知识库类型。

取值范围：

unstructured：文档搜索或音视频类知识库。文档搜索类型的使用场景默认为基础文档问答。<props="china">如需创建其他场景还需传递knowledgeType和knowledgeScene参数。</props>

<props="china">

structured：数据查询或图片问答类知识库。

</props>

请注意，知识库创建后将无法更改其类型
parameters.name: structure_type

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

The embedding model used by the knowledge base. The embedding model transforms the original input prompt and knowledge text into numerical vectors for similarity comparison. The text-embedding-v4 model offers comprehensive upgrades over text-embedding-v3 in terms of language support, code snippet quantization, and vector dimensions options, making it suitable for most scenarios. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2842587.html. Valid values:
text-embedding-v4
text-embedding-v3

Default value: empty. When empty, the text-embedding-v3 model is used.


</props>

<props="intl">

The embedding model used by the knowledge base. The embedding model transforms the original input prompt and knowledge text into numerical vectors for similarity comparison. The default text-embedding-v2 model (cannot be changed) supports Chinese and English as well as multiple other languages, and applies normalization to the vector results. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2842587.html. Valid values:
text-embedding-v2

Default value: empty. When empty, the text-embedding-v2 model is used.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">

知识库使用的向量模型。向量模型用于将原始输入prompt和知识文本转换为数值化向量，以便对二者进行相似度比较。text-embedding-v4模型在语种支持、代码片段向量化效果和向量维度选择等方面，相比text-embedding-v3模型进行了全面升级，适用于大部分场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2842587.html。取值范围：
text-embedding-v4
text-embedding-v3

默认值为空，此时使用text-embedding-v3模型。


</props>

<props="intl">

知识库使用的向量模型。向量模型用于将原始输入prompt和知识文本转换为数值化向量，以便对二者进行相似度比较。默认的text-embedding-v2模型（暂不支持更改）除了支持中英文双语外，还支持多种语言，并对向量结果进行归一化处理。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2842587.html。取值范围：
text-embedding-v2

默认值为空，此时使用text-embedding-v2模型。

</props>
parameters.name: embedding_model_name

parameters.help_en:
The reranking model used by the knowledge base. The reranking model is a scoring system external to the knowledge base that calculates similarity scores between the user's question and each text chunk in the knowledge base, sorts the chunks in descending order of score, and returns the top K chunks with the highest scores. Valid values:


<props="china">

qwen3-rerank-hybrid: qwen3-rerank (hybrid) ranking.
qwen3-rerank: qwen3-rerank ranking.
gte-rerank-hybrid: gte-rerank (hybrid) ranking.
gte-rerank: gte-rerank ranking.

</props>

<props="intl">

gte-rerank-hybrid: official ranking.
gte-rerank: gte-rerank ranking.

</props>



<props="china">

Default value: empty. When empty, qwen3-rerank is used.
If you only need semantic ranking, use `qwen3-rerank`. If you need both semantic ranking and text matching features to ensure relevance, use `qwen3-rerank-hybrid`.



</props>

<props="intl">

Default value: empty. When empty, gte-rerank-hybrid is used.
If you only need semantic ranking, use `gte-rerank`. If you need both semantic ranking and text matching features to ensure relevance, use `gte-rerank-hybrid`.



</props>


<props="china">

`gte-rerank-hybrid` and `gte-rerank` will no longer be updated. We do not recommend using them.



</props>
parameters.help_zh:
知识库使用的排序模型。排序模型是位于知识库外部的评分系统，它会计算用户问题与知识库中每个文本切片的相似度分数并按此降序排列，并返回分数最高的前K个文本切片。取值范围：


<props="china">

qwen3-rerank-hybrid：qwen3-rerank(hybrid)排序。
qwen3-rerank：qwen3-rerank排序。
gte-rerank-hybrid：gte-rerank(hybrid)排序
gte-rerank：gte-rerank排序。

</props>

<props="intl">

gte-rerank-hybrid：官方排序。
gte-rerank：gte-rerank排序。

</props>



<props="china">

默认值为空，此时使用qwen3-rerank。
如仅需语义排序，可使用`qwen3-rerank`；若同时需要语义排序和文本匹配特征以确保相关性，建议使用`qwen3-rerank-hybrid`。



</props>

<props="intl">

默认值为空，此时使用gte-rerank-hybrid。
如仅需语义排序，可使用`gte-rerank`；若同时需要语义排序和文本匹配特征以确保相关性，建议使用`gte-rerank-hybrid`。



</props>


<props="china">

`gte-rerank-hybrid`与`gte-rerank`后续停止更新，不建议使用。



</props>
parameters.name: rerank_model_name

parameters.help_en:
The similarity threshold. Only text chunks with a similarity score above this value are recalled. This parameter filters the text chunks returned by the reranking model. Valid values: [0.01, 1.00].

Default value: 0.01
parameters.help_zh:
相似度阈值，仅相似度分数超过此数值的文本切片才会被召回，用于筛选排序模型返回的文本切片。取值范围[0.01-1.00]。

若未指定，默认采用 0.01
parameters.name: rerank_min_score

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

The chunk size, which is the maximum number of characters in each text chunk. When this limit is exceeded:

Intelligent chunking (when `chunkMode` is not specified): The text is likely to be truncated.
Custom chunking (when `chunkMode` is specified): The text is forcibly truncated.

</props>

<props="intl">
The chunk size, which is the maximum number of characters in each text chunk. When this limit is exceeded, the text is likely to be truncated.
</props>


Valid values: [1, 6000]. Default value: 500.

If `ChunkSize` is set to a value less than 100, you must also set `OverlapSize`. You can also leave both parameters unspecified, and the system will use the default values
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">

分段长度，即每个文本切片的字符数上限。超过该长度时：

智能切分（未指定`chunkMode`）：文本很可能会被截断。
自定义切分（指定了`chunkMode`）：文本将被强制截断。

</props>

<props="intl">
分段长度，即每个文本切片的字符数上限。超过该长度时，文本很可能会被截断。
</props>


取值范围[1-6000]。若未指定，默认采用 500。

若设置了`ChunkSize`且小于100，则必须同时设置`OverlapSize`。您也可以不指定这2个参数，系统将使用默认值
parameters.name: chunk_size

parameters.help_en:
The chunk overlap size, which is the number of overlapping characters between the current text chunk and the previous text chunk. Valid values: [0, 1024].

Default value: 100.
`OverlapSize` must be less than `ChunkSize`. Otherwise, chunking errors may occur
parameters.help_zh:
分段重叠长度，表示当前文本切片与前一个文本切片的重叠字符数。取值范围[0-1024]。

若未指定，默认采用 100。
`OverlapSize`必须小于`ChunkSize`，否则将导致切分异常
parameters.name: overlap_size

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

The sentence separator. This parameter takes effect only when `chunkMode` is set to regex (it has no effect in other modes even if specified). You can pass a single regular expression (multiple expressions are not supported) to split the file into small text chunks.

When using intelligent chunking (when `chunkMode` is not specified), keep the default empty value.

</props>


<props="intl">

This parameter is not available. Do not pass a value for this parameter.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">

分句标识符，仅在`chunkMode`=regex时生效（其他模式下即使传入也不生效）。可传入一个正则表达式（不支持多个），用于将文件分割为小段的文本切片。

使用智能切分（未指定`chunkMode`）时，保持默认空值即可。

</props>


<props="intl">

该参数暂不开放，请勿传入。
</props>
parameters.name: separator

parameters.help_en:
<notice>In the latest version of the SDK, this parameter is required. If not specified, calling the SubmitIndexJob operation will return the error: Required parameter(data_sources) missing or invalid.></notice>

The data source type for importing data. Valid values:
DATA_CENTER_CATEGORY: Category type. Imports all files under the specified categories in <props="china">application data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">application data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props>. Multiple categories can be imported at the same time.
DATA_CENTER_FILE: File type. Imports specified files from <props="china">application data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">application data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props>. Multiple files can be imported at the same time.

If this parameter is set to DATA_CENTER_CATEGORY, you must specify the `CategoryIds` parameter. If this parameter is set to DATA_CENTER_FILE, you must specify the `DocumentIds` parameter.


To create an empty knowledge base, use an empty category: set this parameter to DATA_CENTER_CATEGORY and set `CategoryIds` to the ID of an empty category
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>此参数在最新版SDK中已改为必传，否则调用 SubmitIndexJob 接口将报错：Required parameter(data_sources) missing or invalid。></notice>

导入数据来源。取值范围：
DATA_CENTER_CATEGORY：类目类型，即导入<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props>中指定类目下的所有文件，可同时导入多个类目。
DATA_CENTER_FILE：文件类型，即导入<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props>下的指定文件，可同时导入多个文件。

如果本参数传入DATA_CENTER_CATEGORY，则必须指定`CategoryIds`参数；如果本参数传入DATA_CENTER_FILE，则必须指定`DocumentIds`参数。


要创建空知识库，可使用不含文件的空类目：本参数传入DATA_CENTER_CATEGORY，`CategoryIds`传入空类目 ID

ADB: AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL database. Recommended if you need advanced features such as database management, auditing, and monitoring.

Specifies whether to use the first row of all xlsx and xls files as the table header and append it to each text chunk, preventing the large model from treating the header row as regular data.

Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Default value: false

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

Enables custom chunking and specifies the chunking strategy. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807740.html.

Valid values (multiple values cannot be specified at the same time):

length: Chunk by length. Strictly chunks according to the `ChunkSize` and `OverlapSize` values you specify. If you do not specify these two parameters, the system uses the default values (`ChunkSize`: 500, `OverlapSize`: 100). Length-based chunking does not support `Separator` (it has no effect even if specified).
page: Chunk by page. If `ChunkSize` is specified, it is also considered during chunking (if not specified, the default value of 500 is used). Page-based chunking does not support `OverlapSize` or `Separator` (they have no effect even if specified).
h1: Chunk by level-1 heading. If `ChunkSize` is specified, it is also considered during chunking (if not specified, the default value of 500 is used). Level-1 heading chunking does not support `OverlapSize` or `Separator` (they have no effect even if specified).
h2: Chunk by level-2 heading. If `ChunkSize` is specified, it is also considered during chunking (if not specified, the default value of 500 is used). Level-2 heading chunking does not support `OverlapSize` or `Separator` (they have no effect even if specified).
regex: Chunk by regular expression. The `Separator` parameter must be specified. If `ChunkSize` is specified, it is also considered during chunking (if not specified, the default value of 500 is used). Regular expression chunking does not support `OverlapSize` (it has no effect even if specified).

Default value: intelligent chunking.


</props>

<props="intl">

This parameter is not available. Do not pass a value for this parameter.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">

启用自定义切分，并指定切分策略。更多说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807740.html。

可能取值（不支持同时传入多个值）：

length：按长度切分。严格按照您指定的`ChunkSize`和`OverlapSize`切分。  若您未传入这两个参数，系统将采用默认值（`ChunkSize`为500，`OverlapSize`为100）。按长度切分不支持`Separator`（即使传入也不生效）。
page：按页切分。如果指定了`ChunkSize`，切分时将一并考虑（未传入时，将使用默认值500）。按页切分不支持`OverlapSize`和`Separator`（即使传入也不生效）。
h1：按照一级标题切分。如果指定了`ChunkSize`，切分时将一并考虑（未传入时，将使用默认值 500）。按照一级标题切分不支持`OverlapSize`和`Separator`（即使传入也不生效）。
h2：按照二级标题切分。如果指定了`ChunkSize`，切分时将一并考虑（未传入时，将使用默认值 500）。按照二级标题切分不支持`OverlapSize`和`Separator`（即使传入也不生效）。
regex：按照正则切分，此时必须指定`Separator`参数。如果指定了`ChunkSize`，切分时将一并考虑（未传入时，将使用默认值 500）。按正则切分不支持`OverlapSize`（即使传入也不生效）。

若未指定，默认采用智能切分。


</props>

<props="intl">

该参数暂不开放，请勿传入。

</props>

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">
The specific knowledge type, which further specifies the kind of data the knowledge base processes.
<notice>This parameter and knowledgeScene must be provided together or omitted together. They cannot be set independently. If both are omitted, the system uses the default configurations based on structureType.></notice>

Settings constraints: The value of this parameter must match the structureType you select, and it determines the available values for knowledgeScene.

Valid values:
document: Document search. Must be used with structureType: unstructured.
table: Data query. Must be used with structureType: structured.
image: Image Q&A. Must be used with structureType: structured.
multimedia: Audio/video search. Must be used with structureType: unstructured.

</props>


<props="intl">This parameter is not available. Do not pass a value for this parameter.</props>

设置约束: 此参数的取值必须与您选择的 structureType 匹配，并决定了 knowledgeScene 的可用值。

取值范围：
document: 文档搜索。需与 structureType: unstructured 配合使用。
table: 数据查询。需与 structureType: structured 配合使用。
image: 图片问答。需与 structureType: structured 配合使用。
multimedia: 音视频搜索。需与 structureType: unstructured 配合使用。

</props>


<props="intl">该参数暂不开放，请勿传入。</props>

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">
Specifies the instruction intervention mode for the reranking model to determine its scoring preference.

Valid values:

qa: (Default) Question-and-answer mode. The model assigns higher scores to candidates that directly answer the query. Recommended for Q&A scenarios.

similar: Similarity mode. The model assigns higher scores to candidates that are highly consistent with the query content. Recommended for matching and retrieval scenarios.

custom: Custom mode. The ranking behavior of the model is determined by the instruction in the rerank_instruct parameter.

</props>

<props="intl">This parameter is not available. Do not pass in a value.</props>
[_single.params.RerankMode.enum.similar: 相似模式。]similar: similarity mode.
[_single.params.RerankMode.enum.custom: 自定义模式。]custom: custom mode.
[_single.params.RerankMode.enum.qa:（默认值） 问答模式。]qa: (default) question-and-answer mode.
[parameters.33.schema.enumValueTitles.similar: 相似模式。]similar: similarity mode.
[parameters.33.schema.enumValueTitles.custom: 自定义模式。]custom: custom mode.
[parameters.33.schema.enumValueTitles.qa:（默认值） 问答模式。]qa: (default) question-and-answer mode
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">
指定重排序模型的指令干预模式，以决定其评分偏好。

可选值：

qa:（默认值） 问答模式。模型倾向于为能直接回答查询（Query）的候选项赋予更高分。建议在问答场景使用。

similar: 相似模式。模型倾向于为与查询内容一致性高的候选项赋予更高分。建议在匹配检索场景使用。

custom: 自定义模式。模型的排序行为由 rerank_instruct 参数中的指令决定。

</props>

<props="intl">该参数暂不开放，请勿传入。</props>
parameters.name: rerank_mode

parameters.example: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query.
parameters.help_en:
<props="intl">This parameter is not available. Do not pass in a value.</props>

<props="china">Provides a natural language instruction to fine-tune the behavior of the reranking model.
<notice>This parameter takes effect only when rerank_mode is set to "custom".></notice></props>
parameters.help_zh:

<notice>此参数仅在 rerank_mode 设置为 "custom" 时生效。></notice></props>
